text:
sophie_partners: Need a focused smoke plan to validate retail POC connectors (Snowflake, Databricks Delta, Qdrant/Milvus) prior to packaging for marketplace. Target week of Apr 20. Who can own infra and partner creds?

mike_infra: I can run infra and CI jobs. Suggest tiny dataset s3://redwood-tests/retail-mini-5m. 2h smoke then 12h soak. Need creds and connector versions.

lina_integrations: I'll coordinate versions with partners: SF v1.3.x and v1.4-rc, DBX v2.0 and our shim. Schema: product_id, ts, price, embedding[].

kevin_hw: AuroraEdge offered A40 pool for index experiments. Good to validate index build times vs cloud.

anna_sales: I'll request dev warehouses from Snow and a DBX dev cluster. Mark as partner-only dry-run.

mike_infra: Smoke checklist:
```
- deploy connectors (SF, DBX)
- ingest 100k rows with embeddings
- run 30m concurrent queries (5 clients)
- verify schema fidelity, no dropped fields
- simulate transient network loss and observe restarts
```

mia_qc: I'll own verification harness: schema diffs, sample checks, and 10 regression prompts for embeddings. Will post results to a gist.

lina_integrations: Add tests for DBX DELTA merges (upserts) and Snowflake COPY INTO. Normalize timestamps (epoch ms vs ISO).

mike_infra: Ingest command:
```
./tools/run_ingest.sh --dataset s3://redwood-tests/retail-mini-5m --target snowflake --concurrency 8 --batch 512 --trace smoke-2934
```

devops-bot: CI pipeline created: https://ci.internal/rw/pipelines/adapter-smoke-2934. Jobs added.

kevin_hw: For A40 nodes, label `aurora-small` and limit parallel index builders to 2. Sending reservation window.

anna_sales: Partners asked for a 1-page plan. Lina/Mike, can you draft? Include rollback/fallback for connectors.

mia_qc: Success criteria: schema match >99.5%, no connector crashes in 2h, vector query p95 <200ms at 5qps. Fail if not met.

lina_integrations: After a clean smoke, we'll draft connector.yaml for marketplace metadata (supported versions, knobs, residency).

mike_infra: I'll provision k8s jobs and Grafana (ingest-rate, error-rate, connector-uptime). PR by EOD Mon.

sophie_partners: Great. Keep updates short here. Post one-line completion notes when each smoke run finishes (e.g., "snowflake smoke - pass - 2023-04-21T10:23Z"). Thanks :sparkles:
